to all generations: Heb. to generation and generation
Rahab: Or, Egypt | with thy strong arm: Heb. with the arm of thy strength
a mighty arm: Heb. an arm with might
the LORD is our defense, and the holy One of Israel is our king: Or, our shield is of the LORD, and our king is of the holy One of Israel
break my statutes: Heb. profane my statutes
suffer my faithfullness: Heb. I will not make void from him | to fail: Heb. to lie
that I will not lie: if I lie
